gen-gf-nata-sans-fs-karma: Approachable Nata Sans draws pipe-cleaner strokes and an open-tailed g over Karma. Karma leaves the heading to a few large words, classic serif heft under that midzone.
gen-gf-noticia-text-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Noticia Text leaves the g curls wide, a refined serif with almost no cap-to-body step. Be Vietnam Pro brings rod-straight strokes and a raised waist, a plain sans under that classic heading.
gen-gf-noticia-text-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy, a wide-open e and hefty lowercase under refined Noticia Text. Merriweather Sans keeps copy moving, a plain sans with a clearly right-facing e.
gen-gf-noto-kufi-arabic-fs-erode: Modern Noto Kufi Arabic looks bold because its bodies fill the line, bowls left inviting. And Noto Kufi Arabic wants a few large words, while Erode handles the long stretch with a gentle ebb of weight.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-archivo: Noto Naskh Arabic is a dignified serif with a raised waist and a gentle weight shift. Archivo answers with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, so serif and sans share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-fs-asap: Asap reads as open arcs under dignified Noto Naskh Arabic. Asap keeps copy moving with a body height that nearly matches the caps, a plain sans under that gentle serif stress.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-fs-fira-sans: Noto Naskh Arabic is a dignified serif, a barely tilted nib with a raised waist. And Fira Sans sits contrast-free beside it, wide s turns and a large x-height on a level sans-serif.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-fs-public-sans: Dignified Noto Naskh Arabic keeps a raised waist and a gentle weight shift over Public Sans. Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad mouths, so the two share one sheet.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-fs-supreme: Supreme is a crisp plain sans under Noto Naskh Arabic. Supreme's heavy middle strip against that quiet serif modulation is the hook, letters held open, not curled shut.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-general-sans: General Sans holds a steady pen and a full x-height under Noto Naskh Arabic. And a half-step drop in the copy still reads, a contrast-free sans-serif under that quiet serif.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-manrope: Dignified Noto Naskh Arabic keeps a raised waist and a mild stem-to-curve shift. Noto Naskh Arabic leads in a short line; Manrope does the long stretch on a one-width pen with bright mouths.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-montserrat: Quiet serif stress over geometric wire: Noto Naskh Arabic against Montserrat. And Montserrat glides on one gauge with oversized counters, so heading and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-satoshi: Dignified Noto Naskh Arabic keeps a raised waist and a moderate, easy contrast. And Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and one-width strokes, so serif and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-switzer: Noto Naskh Arabic is a dignified serif, a tempered spring-wire contrast and a raised waist. Switzer answers with tubular letters, so heading and sans-serif share the sheet.
gen-gf-noto-naskh-arabic-work-sans: Slightly thinner crossbars mark Noto Naskh Arabic, a dignified serif with a raised waist. And Work Sans answers with neon-tube consistency, so heading and sans-serif share the sheet.
